profile: I'm Arun from Tirupur, Tamil Nadu, working from home. Today I'm a VR developer: Unity, Meta Quest walkthroughs and games, AR storybooks. I want to move out of development (AI will take much of it) into sales, and from there grow into a project or product manager. I love talking to people, but I have little experience and I get scared to start, so I need to build the mindset and confidence step by step. Working from home in a small city, I don't have a big network yet. I want one mentor for everything: tell me the exact right move for my situation, and if you don't know, point me to who does. Short, simple answers with a clear next step. I speak English and Tamil.
